challenge_strata.rule: The canonical record carries a PriorSurveySeed source database, source identifier, or provenance event.
The abstract is empty after Unicode whitespace normalization.
The nonempty abstract contains 1 through 79 Unicode word tokens.
Title or abstract contains a frozen case-insensitive cue for immersive/large-display environments or conversational, adaptive, recommender, mixed-initiative, or agentic assistance.
Title contains a frozen case-insensitive survey, review, bibliometric, protocol, framework, poster, demo, workshop, position-paper, or editorial cue.

shortfall_handling: Assign each record only to its first matching stratum. Abort before drawing if any exclusive stratum has fewer than six records; do not outcome-condition or silently reallocate the quota.
selection_algorithm: SHA-256 rank without replacement, version title-abstract-benchmark-sampler-v1. Challenge records are the six lowest ranks within each exclusive stratum. The 70-record random set is the lowest independent random rank among the remaining canonical records. Calibration uses an independent rank after excluding all evaluation records and every known related-version component touching evaluation. Secondary A is the 25 lowest secondary-A ranks in the 100-record evaluation set; Secondary B is the 25 lowest secondary-B ranks among the remaining 75.
related_version_policy: Known related-version links remain bibliographically distinct. They are used only as a separation constraint: a component touching evaluation cannot contribute a calibration record.
